      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly modifies `src/index/txindex.cpp` (+41/-21) to handle index corruption and distinguish I/O errors from missing transactions.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents silent failure where index database corruption or read failures are returned as missing transactions. Ryanofsky noted that 'a confirmed transaction reported as missing is the wrong answer, and each path that turned an I/O or index error into \"not found\" now throws instead.'"
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has label RPC/REST/ZMQ and modifies `src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp` to correctly handle and report errors for RPC/REST queries.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes incorrect error reporting where internal I/O errors or block corruption caused RPC methods like `getrawtransaction` to report 'No such transaction found'. This ensures RPC callers receive actionable internal errors instead of false 'missing transaction' results."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
